name: Best Guard Fire Blanket 1.2m x 1.2m
description:
Smothers small fires in the kitchen, workshop or site. Pull the two tapes, cover the burning material completely, switch off the heat and leave it covered until cool. Also for clothing fires. Discard after use.

Size: 1.2m x 1.2m (1.44 m²).
